subject.title: v2026.7.1 Codex extension can strand parent after Completed(None)

question: Should the merged Codex native-subagent recovery from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102060 be selected for the next packaged release, with bundle-level verification?
rationale: Current main addresses the runtime defect, but choosing and validating release backports is a release-owner decision rather than a new implementation decision.

options.title: Backport and verify the bundle
options.body: Recommended: include the merged recovery in the next package and confirm an upgraded installed Codex extension delivers a typed terminal result or reaches its bounded durable failure state.

options.title: Defer to a later release
options.body: Leave the issue open with the affected release range documented until the recovery can be safely selected and verified in a later package.

recommendation.title: Backport and verify the bundle
recommendation.body: Recommended: include the merged recovery in the next package and confirm an upgraded installed Codex extension delivers a typed terminal result or reaches its bounded durable failure state.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged recovery implementation and are the strongest available routing candidate for deciding its release-readiness evidence.
